### 1. User's expression and simulator role
Target object: last week's truck bill ("the bill still shows the full truck rental … the move-in truck comes free … put right on the truck bill"); action boundary: "whatever is owed to you on that truck bill handled on this call … happy for the agent to make the changes"; authorization: verbal consent for agent-side writes; identity given on request (phone + DOB + DL last4, ZIP spare). The simulator is passive: it never raises the Sunday booking; it cancels it itself only when the agent explains it blocks the benefit and hands the cancellation over with a fee (user-owned tool `cancel_truck_reservation_ee0618b8`). Call ends once told "the truck rental itself has been credited".

### 2. Act / wait / refuse at the frozen moment
Act now. Visible grounds: free move-in eligibility terms 1–6 (`free_move_in_truck_eligibility_and_window_c31fc9d0`): class 10 ft eligible (class terms table "Yes | 50 | 7"); linked unit K-214 active, same customer; pickup 2026-10-02 "not later than the unit move-in date plus the class's pickup-window days" (10-03 + 7); the lower bound applies "for a reserved unit whose move-in is scheduled", and in any case 10-02 ≥ 10-03 − 7. Once-per-unit (`free_move_in_once_per_unit_9b734cee` cl. 4): reserved rental 7883803b linked to K-214 is "a separate record holding that unit's free move-in truck rental" — so the benefit cannot be credited on c24ce5ff while it stands; clause 2 "A cancelled or no-show reservation does not use the benefit".

### 3. Narrowest object, keys, include/exclude
Contract c24ce5ff (returned). Claimed unit = K-214 (e85e7727): "the renter's storage unit with the most recent move-in, which is the storage agreement of the renter's latest storage administrative fee" (`free_move_in_claim_and_mileage_credit_b750238a`) — admin fee 2026-10-03 on e85e7727. Exclude L-033 (older admin fee) and its cancelled AutoPay ("Only the authorization for the claimed storage agreement is read"). ### 4. Scored parameters
(a) **Late cancellation fee for 7883803b** (cancelled at 2026-10-10 14:20; free only up to 2026-10-10 09:00 = pickup − 24 h, so late — `cancellation_and_no_show_terms` (a), fee table 10 ft: 24 h, 25.00).
- Computation doc `late_cancellation_fee_amount_fa540e1f`: flat figure 25.00 -> **fall-back 25.00**.
- Factor `cancellation_fee_basis_by_booked_days`: booked days 10-11 -> 10-13 = 2 -> larger of base rate 29.95 and 25.00 = 29.95 (found from the reservation's scheduled dates).
- Factor `cancellation_notice_share`: 10-10 -> 10-11 = 1 calendar day -> 0.75 (found from cancellation date vs scheduled pickup date).
- Factor `cancellation_peak_pickup_day_multiple`: 2026-10-11 is a Sunday -> 1.5.
- Factor `cancellation_courtesy_for_storage_tenants`: active agreements are at PHX-027, reservation facility PHX-031 -> tier 1 no; storage rent billed 2026-10-03 (< 12 months) -> tier 2 -> 0.75 (found from Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement records + ledger rent charges).
- 29.95 × 0.75 × 1.5 × 0.75 = 25.2703125 -> **25.27** (rounded once).

(b) **Additional rental day charge on c24ce5ff**: rental days started = 1 calendar day (10-02 -> 10-03) + 1 (11:40 later than 09:15) = 2; booked = 2 (10-02 09:15 -> 10-04 09:15, 09:15 not later); additional = min(2,2) − 1 = **1**; service date = actual return date **2026-10-03** (`additional_rental_day_count_and_charge_3038b8ae` items 1–5).
- Computation doc: class base rate × days -> **fall-back 29.95**.
- Factor `additional_day_rate_by_booking_length`: booked (dates) 2 -> rate = first-day fee posted on actual pickup date "as posted" = 32.95.
- Factor `second_rental_day_weekday_multiple`: pickup Friday 10-02, second day Saturday -> 1.2.
- Factor `last_rental_day_return_time_share`: returned on the day the last rental day began (10-03, 11:40 > 09:15), within booked days, no later than 12:00 -> last (only) additional day counts 0.5.
- Factor `storage_move_in_day_share_on_additional_days`: K-214 active, move-in 10-03 = actual return date, at another facility (PHX-027 ≠ PHX-031) -> 0.75.
- 32.95 × 1.2 × 0.5 × 0.75 = 14.8275 -> **14.83** (half-up / Python float round; see rounding note).

(c) **Included-miles credit (claim) on c24ce5ff**, after (b) is posted:
- Computation doc `included_miles_credit_amount_07cf67db`: allowance = class free move-in included miles 50; credited miles = min(230, 50) = 50; × 0.99 -> **fall-back 49.50**.

(d) **Rental waiver on c24ce5ff** (root), after (c):
- Computation doc `rental_waiver_amount_eec6032c`: waiver amount = first-day fee as posted 32.95; credited = min(waiver, balance owed) -> **fall-back 32.95** (balance ≈ 95.35).
